result.rationale: In hubspot/lib/CalendarService.ts the diff wraps hubspotClient.oauth.tokensApi.createToken with refreshOAuthTokens, whose sync-mode branch returns a raw `fetch` Response (packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/refreshOAuthTokens.ts). The subsequent code treats the result as a HubspotToken object (accessing accessToken, refreshToken to compute an expiry offset), which would be undefined on a Response, producing NaN expiry and persisting an invalid key — a concrete correctness defect in the introduced code path.

adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/refreshOAuthTokens.ts`, when `APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED && process.env.CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT && userId` is true, the helper returns the raw `fetch(...)` result (a `Response`). In `packages/app-store/hubspot/lib/CalendarService.ts`, `hubspotRefreshToken` is still typed as `HubspotToken` and is assigned from `await refreshOAuthTokens(...)`. With credential sync enabled, this will be a `Response` object rather than the HubSpot token payload, so subsequent property reads on `hubspotRefreshToken` (used to compute expiry / persist refreshed credentials) will be incorrect or undefined, leading to broken refresh/persist behavior.
